notes: Morning = specialty library only (no seasons). Night = creative sky pack by default; holidays + full moon still override. Current-season storefront only mixes into creatives (never wrong-season). Holiday windows may rotate multiple holiday plates. Full moon image ONLY on actual full-moon nights. HARD RULE (Founder 2026-08-06): every night creative must include a clear Sacred Ground visual anchor IN THE PHOTO (storefront / logo-sun bat-signal / glowing SACRED GROUND in landscape). Pure generic aurora/sky is not enough. Overlay logo+footer still apply but do not replace in-photo SG identity. HARD RULE (Founder 2026-08-09): never pick daytime-sun / sun-in-sky plates for week_ahead — retire under creative_pool_retired_daytime_sun (daytime_sun=true). HARD RULE FINAL (Founder 2026-08-12 ~5:54pm CT): never_reuse lifetime block — any URL in image_usage history is permanently blocked; fail closed rather than silently reuse. Active creative_pool = sg_identity pass only + not daytime_sun; failures live in creative_pool_needs_sg_identity until regenerated. See docs/NIGHT-CREATIVES.md and .cursor/rules/night-image-sacred-ground.mdc. HARD RULE (Founder 2026-08-10): when a shop appears use real Sacred Ground storefront resemblance; invented facades banned; circular logo bottom-left on social plates. NEW night gens: designed-in shop pride required.

daytime.how_it_works: Specialty library images only. No seasonal or holiday overlays for morning posts.

nighttime.celestial_notes: Night-before celestial plates + tomorrow openers live in celestial_events.json (not duplicated here). Morning-of plates also live there and win in select_today_image.
nighttime.base_style: Sacred Ground night creatives MUST show Sacred Ground in the picture: storefront, circular logo/folk-art sun as sky or moon mark, bat-signal searchlights, or glowing SACRED GROUND in landscape — plus eggplant-purple storefront seasonals mixed into the creative pool. Pure northern lights / Milky Way / star trails with no SG cue are forbidden. Do NOT use daytime sun / sun-dominating-sky plates for week_ahead. When a storefront plate is used: tan stone facade, deep EGGPLANT PURPLE awnings, white SACRED GROUND lettering with NO swoosh between the words.
nighttime.awning_swoosh: none — leave blank eggplant space between SACRED and GROUND

full_moon.source_note: Dedicated full-moon storefront. Never use on non-full-moon nights.

nighttime.how_it_combines: Priority: (1) celestial night-before from config/celestial_events.json → dated plate + tomorrow opener; (2) full moon night → full-moon image only; (3) holiday window → rotate that holiday’s urls (Christmas includes forest tree); (4) else rotate creative night skies by day among sg_identity=pass + not daytime_sun plates only, permanently skipping any URL already in image_usage (never_reuse lifetime block) and failing closed when the unused pool is empty; current-season storefront at most every 5th creative-mode night and never after a storefront streak. Founder Screenshot exteriors are not part of the night pool. Events stay in caption. Week-ahead horizon is 2 days. Plates in creative_pool_needs_sg_identity / creative_pool_retired_daytime_sun are excluded. creative_pool_ready_local holds SG-pass regenerations awaiting WP upload. NEW gens require designed-in shop pride.
nighttime.sg_identity_rule: Every week_ahead night plate needs an in-photo Sacred Ground anchor. sg_identity must be pass for creative_pool entries. Overlays alone are not enough.
nighttime.daytime_sun_rule: Founder 2026-08-09: sun-in-sky / sun-dominating plates read as daytime and must never be selected for week_ahead. Tag daytime_sun=true (or night_mood=daytime_sun / family=daytime_sun) and keep them out of the active pool.
